inbound-led-outbound.title: Inbound-led outbound: post engagers into a capped warm sequence
inbound-led-outbound.label: Inbound-led outbound
inbound-led-outbound.summary: Find who engages with you on LinkedIn, score them, and message only the good fits.
inbound-led-outbound.prompt: Turn the people paying attention to us on LinkedIn into pipeline: people reacting to my posts or to posts by people I pick, my followers and connections, or my profile viewers. Score them against our ideal customer and message only the good fits on LinkedIn, a few a day.
trigger_phrases: Turn the people who engage with my LinkedIn posts into pipeline
Who is engaging with my competitors' or my niche creators' posts?
Reach the people engaging with LinkedIn posts about my topic
Turn my LinkedIn connections and followers into pipeline
Turn my LinkedIn profile viewers into leads
I have no lead list. Where do I start on LinkedIn?
inbound-led-outbound.business_case: People who react to a post, follow you or view your profile already know the topic or your name. Capture them, score them against your ideal customer and message only the good fits: warmer than a bought list, and capped.
inbound-led-outbound.outcome: A table of real people with the post or signal that brought each one in, an ICP-fit score on every row, and a capped LinkedIn sequence to the good fits, sent only after LinkedIn is connected and the founder approves.
inbound-led-outbound.leading_metric: Good-fit people per pilot, and positive replies per 10 people messaged
inbound-led-outbound.benchmark: Not measured yet. Judge a source by its good fits per pilot, not by reaction volume: if fewer than 1 in 10 captured people score high, change the source, not the threshold.

effort.time_to_value: posts: scored people in one session; network and viewers: hours to days
effort.cadence: one capped pilot, then an optional daily capture and a weekly send

credits.pilot: ~150: capture 1 profile, 2 posts, 20 people (~142) + score 100 people (~8)
credits.full: Daily capture up to 150 a day if kept on; a LinkedIn account reserves 3,400 a month; messages cost 0

pilot.check: One capped capture, then read the top-scored people with the founder before any message is drafted or sent.

prerequisites.detail: Company, offer and one line on the ideal customer; the scoring prompt quotes it
About 150 credits for the pilot; the free plan's 250 credits cover it
A connected LinkedIn account for followers, connections, viewers and sending (3,400 credits a month); post capture works without one

stages.title: Replies move the CRM lead stage

journey.title: Inbound-led outbound
journey.description: Turn the people who engage with your LinkedIn posts into a capped, evidence-gated warm sequence with replies routed to your CRM.
journey.seed_message: I chose the inbound-led-outbound recipe. Help me turn the people paying attention to me on LinkedIn into conversations: capture a small sample, score each person against my ideal customer, show me the good fits and draft a LinkedIn message I approve. Inspect the workspace first and resume from what exists. Do not connect an account, enroll anyone, send anything, or spend credits without asking me first.

outbound-pilot-50.title: Launch a 50-lead outbound pilot
outbound-pilot-50.label: 50-lead outbound pilot
outbound-pilot-50.summary: 25 decision makers with checked emails and drafted first lines, reviewed before anything sends.
outbound-pilot-50.prompt: Get a small outbound pilot going this week: find about 25 decision makers who fit who we sell to, get their work emails and draft a first email to each for me to review. Tell me what it costs before you spend anything, and send nothing until I say so.
trigger_phrases: I need outbound running this week
Build me a cold outreach pilot
Find 50 leads and draft first emails for me to review
I have no pipeline — start outbound
outbound-pilot-50.business_case: No outbound is running. Find 25 decision makers, their work emails and a first line for each, review them before anything sends, send to those 25, and learn from the replies whether the list and the message work before you send more.
outbound-pilot-50.outcome: A table of 25 (then 50) decision makers with title, company, checked work email and a drafted first line; an email sequence that sends only after your approval; and, once replies hold, a capped way to send more.
outbound-pilot-50.leading_metric: positive replies within 14 days of the first send
outbound-pilot-50.benchmark: 2026-10-04 audit: work emails for 25 people cost about 84 credits (10 verified, 14 catch-all, 1 not found); one search page of up to 50 people costs 1 credit. 1-3 positive replies from about 50 sends is a working signal; 0 means change the list or the message.

pilot.check: Read the 25 names, emails and first lines with the founder, and open the table link, before sending or finding more people.

effort.time_to_value: reviewed drafts in about 20 minutes; replies 2-14 days after sending
effort.cadence: once; send more only after replies hold

credits.pilot: ~125 for 25 people: search 1, emails ~85, first lines ~38
credits.full: ~5 per person; sending is 0 credits but needs inboxes on a separate domain (from 500 a month each)

prerequisites.detail: What you sell and who buys it: the search filters and the first lines use it
About 150 credits for 25 people up to reviewed drafts; sending needs warmed inboxes, which need a paid plan
Only for sending: warmed inboxes on a separate sending domain, from email-infra-setup; never your own work inbox. Without them the pilot stops at reviewed drafts

whole-tam-email.title: Whole-market cold email
whole-tam-email.label: Whole-market cold email
whole-tam-email.summary: Evergreen cold email to your whole market, one segment at a time, with A/B rounds.
whole-tam-email.prompt: Run cold email across our whole market, one segment at a time: three emails per person, a new A/B test each round, and a fresh angle for people who didn't reply after 60 days. Show me the costs and wait for my approval before anything sends.
trigger_phrases: Run cold email across our whole market
Set up evergreen cold email at full capacity
A/B test our cold email CTAs and subject lines
Re-contact the people who never replied
The pilot worked — how do I scale cold email?
Build a repeatable cold email system
whole-tam-email.business_case: Signals decide who goes first but never replace the market lane. This runs cold email to every segment, evergreen and at full capacity: three emails per person, one Sequence per segment, and one A/B variable per round.
whole-tam-email.outcome: One table and one Sequence per segment (industry × size band), batches enrolled oldest rows first, A/B rounds of 2,200 contacts with an auto-winner, and non-repliers re-contacted with a new angle no earlier than 60 days later.
whole-tam-email.leading_metric: reply rate and positive replies per 500 contacted, judged after 1,000 contacted in a segment
whole-tam-email.benchmark: After 1,000 contacted: under 0.37% reply, fix placement and the list, not the copy; scale at 0.7% reply or better with at least 1 positive reply per 500 contacted. The typical reply rate is 0.74%.

effort.time_to_value: a verdict after 1,000 contacted in a segment
effort.cadence: one A/B round at a time; re-contact every 60 days

credits.pilot: copy columns priced by their dry run before they run
credits.full: copy columns per round at the approved ceiling; inboxes sized at 3 emails per contact

prerequisites.detail: Inboxes sized for 3 emails per contact, per the cold email playbook in the oxygen-email-infra skill
One table of contacts per segment (industry × size band)

signal-outbound.title: Signal-based email outbound
signal-outbound.label: Signal-based cold email
signal-outbound.summary: Email people within a day of an intent signal and a week of a market signal.
signal-outbound.prompt: Email the people and companies that just showed a signal: within a week of a market signal like hiring, within 24 hours of an intent signal like a site visit, two emails each, nothing older than 30 days. Show me the costs and wait for my approval before anything sends.
trigger_phrases: Email companies that are hiring for this role
Reach people who just showed buying intent
Turn hiring signals into cold email
Email our website visitors and signups who fit
signal-outbound.business_case: Signals rank who goes first. The first touch goes out within 24 hours of an intent signal and within 7 days of a market signal, and a signal older than 30 days is dropped. The whole-market email lane runs beside this one.
signal-outbound.outcome: One audience table fed by market-signal feeds and daily website-visit and signup reads, verified emails and per-lead copy columns, and a two-email Sequence that only the qualified-audience router enrolls, at most 20 rows a cycle.
signal-outbound.benchmark: At 40 or more sends (about 20 people) with no positive reply, change the angle before blaming the signal; a source that keeps firing without positive replies is paused.

effort.time_to_value: first enrollments on the router's next daily cycle
effort.cadence: the router runs daily at 09:00 UTC by default

credits.pilot: signal search estimated first, then run live at an approved ceiling
credits.full: feeds capped per cycle at the approved ceiling; inboxes sized at 2 emails per contact

prerequisites.detail: Inboxes sized at 2 emails per contact, per the cold email playbook in the oxygen-email-infra skill

multichannel-top-tier.title: Email + LinkedIn for top-tier leads
multichannel-top-tier.label: Email + LinkedIn top tier
multichannel-top-tier.summary: High-fit accounts get email and LinkedIn together; warm signals get LinkedIn first.
multichannel-top-tier.prompt: Reach our highest-fit accounts on both email and LinkedIn: email first for cold top-tier leads, LinkedIn first for people who engaged with my posts or viewed my profile. Wait for my approval before anything sends.
trigger_phrases: Combine email and LinkedIn for our best accounts
Run a multichannel sequence for top-tier leads
Email plus a LinkedIn invite for high-fit accounts
LinkedIn first for warm leads, email as the fallback
multichannel-top-tier.business_case: Invites are capped per LinkedIn account, so LinkedIn cannot carry market volume. Spend it on high-fit accounts and signal leads alongside email, and give the rest of the market the whole-market email play.
multichannel-top-tier.outcome: A cold-order Sequence (three emails, an invite, and a LinkedIn message to people who accept) and a warm-order Sequence (invite and message first, email as the fallback), both sent from one sender profile.
multichannel-top-tier.leading_metric: invite acceptance and LinkedIn reply rate
multichannel-top-tier.benchmark: Acceptance under 25% or LinkedIn reply under 10%: change the audience, not the copy. An unaccepted invite is withdrawn about 14 days after it went out.

effort.time_to_value: after the first invites are accepted
effort.cadence: standing; warm captures can enroll themselves under a standing grant

credits.pilot: copy columns priced by their dry run before they run
credits.full: inboxes sized at 3 emails per contact for the cold order

prerequisites.detail: One sender profile that sends both channels: a connected LinkedIn account and an inbox
The leads in one table with a LinkedIn URL, a verified email and the copy columns
